overview: The Medford School Committee met to review the district's 2026 state accountability and testing results, hear a presentation on a new high school mural, and approve natural gas-powered equipment replacements.

items.title: Consent Agenda
items.summary: The committee approved the consent agenda, which included bills, payroll, minutes, donations to the Best Buddies chapters, and a $653,933.55 end-of-year budget transfer.

items.title: Mustang Moment: Mural Presentation
items.summary: Fine and Performing Arts Director Suzanne Fee and student artists presented "At Our Core," a new five-panel mural installed outside the high school library representing the school's core values.

items.title: State Accountability and Academic Testing Results 2026 Part 1
items.summary: Assistant Superintendent Dr. Kim Talbot presented the first part of the district's 2026 accountability results, highlighting that seven out of eight schools improved their accountability percentiles and exceeded state targets for advanced coursework completion.

items.title: Natural Gas Powered Equipment Replacement
items.summary: The committee approved requests to replace a kitchen stove and hot water tanks with natural gas-powered units, with an amendment that the high school stove be relocated and reused in another facility if possible.

items.title: Student Advisory Council Presentation
items.summary: The committee voted to table this presentation until the next school committee meeting.

items.title: Condolences
items.summary: The committee read condolences for Ralph E. Giddings, Jr., Caroline Luciano Labbadini, and John Bud Bissell, Sr., followed by a moment of silence.
